title: Sidon Set Size Bounds
exact_target: Sharpen the known size estimates for Sidon subsets of an interval, even if the improvement holds only for an infinite sequence of interval lengths.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 162 (GREEN-074). CC BY 4.0.

Daniel Carter, Zach Hunter and Kevin O’Bryant, \emph{On the Diameter of Finite Sidon Sets}, arXiv:2310.20032v1 (2023), §1. It states the equivalent interval extremal problem and Singer and Erdős--Turán benchmarks, and gives the improved upper bound $F(N)\leq\sqrt N+0.98183N^{1/4}+O(1)$.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author list, Problem 31 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
